description:
RevivalSMP — Lifesteal Survival

 Steal hearts. Survive the competition. Become a legend.

 What We Offer:

 • Lifesteal PvP — Kill players to steal their hearts, lose all yours and you're eliminated

 • 1v1 Duels — Challenge anyone to a fair arena fight and climb the leaderboard

 • Persistent World — Your progress carries over, no map resets

 • Java + Bedrock Crossplay — Play from any platform

 • Shards Economy — Earn currency by playing, buy crate keys and items

 • Cosmetics — Particle trails, chat colors, kill effects, and more

 • No Pay-to-Win — Completely free to play, do whatever you want

 Server Specs: AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D | 256 GB RAM | Dedicated Bare Metal

 IP: revivalsmp.net (Java & Bedrock Port 19132)
